note: Model built from the developer’s brochure (June 2026). Floor plates and every showroom and office are traced to scale from its plans for the ground, 1st–2nd, 3rd–20th, 21st (skip), 22nd–31st and 32nd–42nd floors; super built-up areas and sizes are from its tables. Floor-to-floor heights are from its section drawing: 4.5 m ground, 4.275 m showroom floors, 3.2 m on floors 3–20, 3.35 m on floors 21–31 and 3.65 m on floors 32–42, reaching the terrace at 147.65 m. The dark blade on the south face and the crown frame follow the renders; their exact sizes are estimated. Plot, garden and ramp: the brochure site plan, aligned with S.G. Highway and the 12 m road. Surroundings are from OpenStreetMap.
